Subject: Private control plane provisioning - adoption impact assessment

Hi Simon,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. Attached are the schema and a short checklist we use for Private CP identity integrations. To help scope the cutover impact we need three pieces from your side:

1) SAML metadata (EntityID + valid certs) — if you can share the raw metadata XML we can validate cert rotation windows.
2) SCIM base URL and expected attribute mapping (we need the external id, email, displayName, groups).
3) A small test org account we can use to run an end-to-end provisioning dry run (non-prod tenant ok).

Proposed timeline: staging integration 2028-06-05, smoke tests 06-07, production cut 06-14. If that schedule doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Attachments: scim-schema-v2.json (SCIM mapping template), saml-metadata-example.xml

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Simon Hayes <simon.hayes@globex.com>

Subject: Re: Private control plane provisioning - adoption impact assessment

Naomi,

Thanks – see answers inline.

1) SAML metadata - attached (saml-metadata.xml). Our IdP is AuthNexus; EntityID = https://idp.globex.com/saml
2) SCIM URL = https://scim.globex.com/v2. We'll supply attribute mapping spreadsheet by Monday. Groups are supported via "memberOf" and we can include external_id.
3) Test org - we've provisioned a sandbox org named "globex-redwood-staging" (test creds in a separate secure channel).

Note: Security will require a certificate rotation window of at least 30 days notice; we can agree on a key roll plan. Also flagging procurement: we need a signed DPA before prod cutover.

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml

Regards,
Simon Hayes

On Fri, May 11, 2028 at 10:02 AM Simon Hayes <simon.hayes@globex.com> wrote:
> Naomi,
> ...

Thanks for the updates. Technical notes / asks from infra:

- For role mapping we should avoid mapping Globex AD groups directly to Redwood admin role. Recommend template: map AD groups to scoped roles (e.g., priv-admin:org=globex:env=prod, priv-pwruser:org=globex). I'll attach a sample JSON role map.
- Service account provisioning: we need a machine identity for SCIM pushes (OAuth2 client creds). Ask Globex to provision a client with client_id/secret and scopes [scim:write, scim:read] and IP allowlist for our staging egress.
- SCIM incremental sync: Globex said groups via memberOf; we'll test with delta tokens. If they don't support delta, fall back to full sync nightly with chunking.
- Audit logs: request that Globex enable provisioning audit logs for 30 days during cutover window (we'll capture and ship to their S3 for retention compliance).

Attachments: privcp-provisioning-runbook.pdf, role-mapping-sample.json

I'll take point on the test harness. Can Simon share the sandbox creds to our secrets team (I'll loop in dev @ops separately)?

- Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi team,

Quick security review notes after scanning the sample metadata:

- The saml cert uses SHA-256 but expires in 2028-09-02; recommend planning a rotation before 2028-08-01 to allow for testing windows.
- Ensure SP-initiated logout is supported to avoid stale sessions after role changes.
- For SCIM we prefer TLS client cert pinning for the push endpoint; if not possible, strict mTLS with mutual validation.
- Regarding service account secrets: store client_secret in vault with limited read scope and rotate every 90 days.

Happy to run a 30-minute call to step through the runbook during the staging test week.

Best,
Amelia Ross
Security Consultant, RedHook Security
amelia@redhook.io
